notes.title: Crawl release date set, bash giant Gabe Newell next month
notes.notes:
Powerhoof's asymmetric dungeon roamer roguelike Crawl has been in Early Access for so long, I'd actually forgotten it existed. First released into Steam's supported development initiative in August, 2014, it wowed with its multiplayer flare and intuitive catch-up mechanics—and now boasts "Overwhelmingly Positive" aggregate reviews on Steam. It's also now got a launch date: April 11, 2017. 

Before we get to the obligatory launch trailer, here's Powerhoof on what it's all about: 

"Crawl is the local multiplayer dungeon crawler where your friends control the monsters! It’s bullet-hell beat-em-up meets old-school RPG, in an arcadey party-game for up to 4 players. One player is the hero, exploring a randomly generated dungeon full of traps and monsters—all controlled by the other players. If you slay the hero you take their place and it’s your turn to crawl! Then it's a race to gain enough XP and loot to reach the final battle, where it's all on one as the other players collectively control the hulking final boss."

And onto that trailer: 

I dipped my toe into Crawl not long after it landed on Early Access and, despite it being great fun, it also felt like much more was to come. I understand it's since added a whole range of weapons, spells, items, levels, monsters, traps and bosses. At some point it added a giant angry Gabe Newell to the latter category:

Crawl is due April 11, 2017.

notes.title: Update v0.12: Eye Bat
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/sxEn898.gif[/img]

We're here with another Crawl update to bring in the new year! If demonic bat-winged flying eyeballs are your jam we've fleshed out their monster upgrade tree. Then there's new traps, special christmas treats for your hero as well as a horde of tweaks and bug fixes.

[h1]Here's the biggest changes:[/h1]
[list]
	[*][b]Monsters[/b]
	[list]
		[*] An eyebat bomber who fires powerful explosions
		[*] A cluster of three eyebat hatchlings, who work together and can heal eachother
	[/list]
	[*][b]Traps[/b]
	[list]
		[*] The Double Beam Trap fires in two directions, bisecting the battle with its violent searing light
		[*] The Homing Spike Block is magically drawn towards living flesh
		[*] The Dart Spout Trap fires a fast and deadly dart in front or behind
		[*] The Small Spike Block triggers more quickly than its larger brother
	[/list]
	[*] [b]Christmas pressies[/b] for your hero
	[*] [b]And more![/b]
[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/F7tfXSQ.gif[/img]

As usual, you can check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/293780/discussions/0/152391995405951575/]full list of changes on the community forums[/url], and leave us comments in there to tell us what you think!

notes.title: Update v0.11: Vengeful Spectre
notes.notes:
[img]http://imgur.com/iTzp8d1.gif[/img]

Wreak havoc on the living with oodles of new haunting opportunities for spirits.  Farm ectoplasm by rattling chains and bringing paintings to life, or possess stray barrels and furniture to throw at unsuspecting heroes!  If you're feeling fishy, we have a turret-spawning fish-like wizard, and a gargantuan fish with a horribly powerful bite to play with.

[h1]New Stuff:[/h1]
[list]
	[*][b] New Monsters:[/b][list]
		[*] A gargantuan mutated fish with a mighty chomp and a deceptively agile roll
		[*] Magic wielding monks hide their fishlike bodies beneath hooded robes, hurling water spells and summoning beastly fish turrets[/list]
	[*] [b]New Object Haunting System:[/b][list]
		[*] Ghosts can farm ectoplasm by animating props around the dungeon
		[*] Many props can be levitated and thrown as makeshift traps[/list]
	[*] [b]New Usable Objects:[/b][list]
		[*] Paintings, mirrors, shackles, bleeding grates and haunted stocks for ghosts to animate
		[*] Trees can now be drained by heroes to gain Vitality
		[*] Heroes can find bonfires, to rest and regain health[/list]
	[*] [b]Mimics: [/b] Some of our chests can now be inhabited to turn them into vicious monsters
	[*] [b]Halloween Pumpkins![/b] Don't try to eat them, I'm pretty sure they're full of bats
	[*] [b]Loads of tweaks and bug fixes[/b] Yaaay!
[/list]

[img]http://imgur.com/DlItYxT.gif[/img]

Check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/293780/discussions/0/305509857564814442/]full list of changes on the community forums![/url]

notes.title: Update v0.10: Giant Rat
notes.notes:
[img]http://imgur.com/zeboFRK.gif[/img]

Hack and skewer with the vermin soldier's blighted halberd, or spawn a writhing rat army to command with our rodent summoner.  New ways to trick your friends await in the murky depths, with devious artifacts and powerful new magics.

[h1]Major changes:[/h1]
[list]
	[*] New Monsters:
	[list]
		[*] The vermin soldier wields a vicious halberd 
		[*] The rodent summoner commands a writhing rat army
	[/list]
	[*] Reworked Store Teleporter system helps new heroes get to the store for upgrades
	[*] Expanded Magic Weapon system with magic all magic now displayed in weapon art, and new magic types:
	[list]
		[*] Cosmic Strikes
		[*] Explosive Strikes
		[*] Life Steal Strikes
	[/list]
	[*] New Artifacts:
	[list]
		[*] The Medal of Honour makes your spells recharge faster on a kill streak
		[*] The Monster Hand makes your monsters' special attacks recharge faster
		[*] The Hymn of Betrayal robs the leading hero of a random artifact	
	[/list]
[/list]

[img]http://imgur.com/ggQL2Ak.gif[/img]

And as usual there's a whole heap of smaller tweaks and bug fixes this time too, see the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/293780/discussions/0/353916584657418387/]full list of changes on the community forums![/url]

notes.title: Update v0.9: Kevin The Destroyer
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6394316/dd333180627dcc7383fc3c5086be142ad66925b8.gif[/img]

Grind heroes in your beak as the hulking bird abomination, hurl flesh-seeking skulls as the skeletal magelord, inhabit fish, squids and gargoyles or just soak in the stories from our new intro sequences, complete with voice-over from our unhinged narrator.

[h1]Main Changes:[/h1][list][*] Hero Battle Intros: The starting hero is no longer up to chance.  Players battle it out in short randomized intros featuring our ghastly narrator.[*] New Monsters:[list][*] The gigantic bird abomination grinds heroes in his beak	[*] The mind squid draws hulking tentacles from the earth	[*] The gargoyle defends by turning to stone	[*] The skeletal magelord throws flesh-seeking skulls	[*] The tiny fish is... kind of useless.  Or is he?	[/list][*] New Artifacts:	[list]	[*] The Vampire Tooth drinks health from striking enemies when you're bleeding	[*] Cadaver Burst triggers a last-ditch explosion from your monster's corpse	[*] The Emerald Signet heals you when poisoned	[/list][*] New Traps[list]	[*] The Dart Array spits a sequence of darts from an array hidden in the decaying walls	[*] The Spike Train triggers a course of spikes that pierces the sod, and the flesh of any who stand upon it	[*] The Dart Trap	fires a cruel dart at any intruder that dares to cross in front	[/list][/list]

[h1]Also new this time around:[/h1]
[list]
[*]New music for the mines
[*]Hero Info GUI- Your Stats and equipment are now displayed when you're in the store. No more trying to remember what you have!

notes.title: Update v0.3: Plague Mushroom
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/VCzvRUy.png[/img]
Strange new monsters and gods have been summoned to the catacombs.  Ready yourself with powers from our new interactive props – a second hulking boss creature has been discovered!

[h1]Among the huge list of changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]New boss battle[/b]–  cooperate with your friends to walk a giant hydra around the battle field, firing ice, flame and goo, while the hero works to chop off your heads!
[*] [b]Control 5 new monsters[/b]–  be a spear-wielding servant, a putrid mushroom, a gluttonous tentacled abomination, a possessed priestess, or a magical hooded haunt.
[*] [b]Worship 4 new deities[/b], each with new a unique hero buff.
[*] [b]New Interactive Scenery[/b]– read from magic tomes, risk a drink from an ancient fountain, or deface a tombstone to enhance your abilities.
[/list]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/4vGvk8u.gif[/img]

We’ve rebalanced existing monsters based on your feedback, and there’s a huge number of other tweaks, improvements and bug fixes - check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/293780/discussions/0/616199347848628426/]full list of changes on the community forums![/url]

Have fun!

notes.title: Crawl Minor Update v0.01.02
notes.notes:
Just a minor update to add some more controller support and fix a few issues. Gameplay features, new content and balancing are still to come in the first major update next month!

Here's the changelist -

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list][*]Steam Cloud support: You no longer have to unlock everything again on each machine you play on!
	[b]NB:[/b] The first machine you play on with the update will sync it's existing progress to steam cloud.  After that other machines you play on will take the progress that's in the cloud. (So play on the machine with the most progress first!)
[*]Added direction control calibration (up/down/left/right). You should be able calibrate and use "retro" controllers and arcade sticks now.
[*]Keyboard can now be set up to have multiple players. Choose [i]Keyboard Setup[/i] in the options menu to set your keys.
[*]You can now use the mouse to navigate the front menus.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list][*]Mouse controls no longer break after finishing a game using the mouse.
[*]Fixed single controller being able to join and control multiple players. (eg: DualShock4 on Linux)
[*]Fixed discounted store items marked as "can't afford" incorrectly when player had exact amount of gold.
[*]Safe zone values no longer load incorrectly and mess up the GUI on Linux.
[*]Corrected spelling of vampiric ring.
[*]Hero arrows no longer hit the wall behind when fired.
[*]Bot ghosts no longer hover over pentagram without using it.
[*]Bots no longer continuously try and shoot chests/crystals with bow when there's a wall in the way.
[/list]
Next up I'll be working on some of the balance issues we've been discussing on the community forums. Barney's been working on some new monsters, and he's heading off to the US for PAX Prime this week. We're not showing Crawl off on the PAX show floor, but if you're in Seattle you can wander around the corner to the free [url=http://six.seattleindi.es]Seattle Indies Expo[/url] and play there. Barney will be hanging around so try and hunt him down for a game!
